verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a full agent-oriented docs surface. A live probe confirms llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with explicit agent usage instructions telling agents to fetch plain-text files instead of the JavaScript-shell HTML. Alongside it Ramp publishes per-guide .txt exports, llms-api.txt, llms-full.txt and a parseable OpenAPI spec (probed, 174 paths). It also offers an unauthenticated Developer MCP docs server, an agents.ramp.com page with a markdown alternate, and automation recommendations that tell agents which channel to use.
